ns2:section.sectionText: 2 or 4 hours. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Open only to new LEEP students beginning program in Summer 2008. Session 1: The on-campus dates are JULY 10 through JULY 19, 2008. Students must also enroll in one of the three discussion sections to complete enrollment in the course: 502LA1--32649; 502LA2--32650; 502LA3--32651; 502LA4--33823. Enrollment instructions will be forthcoming. Do not attempt to enroll yourself in the course. Departmental approval is required.
